title: factorQuotient has the expected degree bound: polyDegreeLt (factorQuotient c a n) n
statement: For any coefficient function c, root candidate a, and n : Nat: polyDegreeLt (factorQuotient c a n) n -- the computed synthetic-division quotient satisfies the degree bound the factor theorem needs. The proof rebuilds factorQuotient's own Nat.rec shape (motive/base/step) so the ascribed Equiv is defeq to 'Equiv (factorQuotient c a n k) zero' for k >= n, transported through the forced-zero base case discussed in F:complex-factorquotient's own notes.

formal.statement: theorem Complex.factorQuotient_degreeLt : ((x0 : ((x0 : AxNat) -> Complex)) -> ((x1 : Complex) -> ((x2 : AxNat) -> Complex.polyDegreeLt (Complex.factorQuotient x0 x1 x2) x2)))

evidence.supports: Complex.factorQuotient_degreeLt is admitted by the trusted kernel gate with the type recorded in formal.statement.
evidence.checker_command: cargo run -q --release -p axeyum-lean-kernel --example theorem_dependency_inventory -- Complex.factorQuotient_degreeLt 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^Complex\.factorQuotient_degreeLt[[:space:]]'
evidence.notes: The producing prelude admits Complex.factorQuotient_degreeLt through the trusted Kernel::add_declaration gate, which re-checks the proof term against the stated type. theorem_dependency_inventory exits non-zero for a named filter matching nothing (a deleted/renamed theorem cannot read as a re-derived one), and grep -c (never -q) both avoids a SIGPIPE-under-pipefail false negative and independently asserts the exact tab-anchored line is present. --release is MANDATORY: this tool also builds creal/complex/cpoint, which overflow the default debug thread stack.
